data.name: courses
constraints: CHECK (term_start IS NULL OR term_end IS NULL OR term_start <= term_end)

data.name: tasks
constraints:
CHECK (
      (deadline_kind = 'none' AND deadline_date IS NULL AND deadline_utc IS NULL
        AND deadline_zone IS NULL AND deadline_boundary_utc IS NULL) OR
      (deadline_kind = 'dateOnly' AND deadline_date IS NOT NULL AND deadline_utc IS NULL
        AND deadline_zone IS NOT NULL AND deadline_boundary_utc IS NOT NULL) OR
      (deadline_kind = 'timed' AND deadline_date IS NULL AND deadline_utc IS NOT NULL
        AND deadline_zone IS NOT NULL AND deadline_boundary_utc IS NOT NULL
        AND deadline_boundary_utc = deadline_utc))

CHECK (target_utc IS NULL OR deadline_kind = 'none' OR
      (deadline_kind = 'dateOnly' AND target_utc < deadline_boundary_utc) OR
      (deadline_kind = 'timed' AND target_utc <= deadline_boundary_utc))

CHECK ((status = 'done' AND completed_at IS NOT NULL) OR
      (status != 'done' AND completed_at IS NULL))

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "courses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(id) = 36 AND substr(id,9,1) = '-' AND substr(id,14,1) = '-' AND substr(id,19,1) = '-' AND substr(id,24,1) = '-' AND length(replace(id,'-','')) = 32 AND replace(id,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND substr(id,15,1) IN ('1','2','3','4','5','6','7','8') AND substr(id,20,1) IN ('8','9','a','b')), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 200), "color" TEXT NULL, "term_start" TEXT NULL CHECK(term_start IS NULL OR (length(term_start) = 10 AND term_start GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND substr(term_start,1,4) != '0000' AND date(term_start,'+0 days') IS NOT NULL AND date(term_start,'+0 days') = term_start)), "term_end" TEXT NULL CHECK(term_end IS NULL OR (length(term_end) = 10 AND term_end GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND substr(term_end,1,4) != '0000' AND date(term_end,'+0 days') IS NOT NULL AND date(term_end,'+0 days') = term_end)), "archived_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (term_start IS NULL OR term_end IS NULL OR term_start <= term_end));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tasks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(id) = 36 AND substr(id,9,1) = '-' AND substr(id,14,1) = '-' AND substr(id,19,1) = '-' AND substr(id,24,1) = '-' AND length(replace(id,'-','')) = 32 AND replace(id,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND substr(id,15,1) IN ('1','2','3','4','5','6','7','8') AND substr(id,20,1) IN ('8','9','a','b')), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(title)) BETWEEN 1 AND 200), "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "next_action" TEXT NULL, "course_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES courses (id), "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('todo','doing','done')), "priority" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(priority IN ('low','normal','high')), "deadline_kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(deadline_kind IN ('none','dateOnly','timed')), "deadline_date" TEXT NULL CHECK(deadline_date IS NULL OR (length(deadline_date) = 10 AND deadline_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND substr(deadline_date,1,4) != '0000' AND date(deadline_date,'+0 days') IS NOT NULL AND date(deadline_date,'+0 days') = deadline_date)), "deadline_utc" INTEGER NULL, "deadline_zone" TEXT NULL CHECK(length(deadline_zone) BETWEEN 1 AND 100), "deadline_boundary_utc" INTEGER NULL, "target_utc" INTEGER NULL, "remaining_minutes" INTEGER NULL CHECK(remaining_minutes >= 0), "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (
      (deadline_kind = 'none' AND deadline_date IS NULL AND deadline_utc IS NULL
        AND deadline_zone IS NULL AND deadline_boundary_utc IS NULL) OR
      (deadline_kind = 'dateOnly' AND deadline_date IS NOT NULL AND deadline_utc IS NULL
        AND deadline_zone IS NOT NULL AND deadline_boundary_utc IS NOT NULL) OR
      (deadline_kind = 'timed' AND deadline_date IS NULL AND deadline_utc IS NOT NULL
        AND deadline_zone IS NOT NULL AND deadline_boundary_utc IS NOT NULL
        AND deadline_boundary_utc = deadline_utc)), CHECK (target_utc IS NULL OR deadline_kind = 'none' OR
      (deadline_kind = 'dateOnly' AND target_utc < deadline_boundary_utc) OR
      (deadline_kind = 'timed' AND target_utc <= deadline_boundary_utc)), CHECK ((status = 'done' AND completed_at IS NOT NULL) OR
      (status != 'done' AND completed_at IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "subtasks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(id) = 36 AND substr(id,9,1) = '-' AND substr(id,14,1) = '-' AND substr(id,19,1) = '-' AND substr(id,24,1) = '-' AND length(replace(id,'-','')) = 32 AND replace(id,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND substr(id,15,1) IN ('1','2','3','4','5','6','7','8') AND substr(id,20,1) IN ('8','9','a','b')), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id), "title" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(title)) BETWEEN 1 AND 200), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(position >= 0), "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "notes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(id) = 36 AND substr(id,9,1) = '-' AND substr(id,14,1) = '-' AND substr(id,19,1) = '-' AND substr(id,24,1) = '-' AND length(replace(id,'-','')) = 32 AND replace(id,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND substr(id,15,1) IN ('1','2','3','4','5','6','7','8') AND substr(id,20,1) IN ('8','9','a','b')), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(title) <= 200), "body" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(body) <= 100000), "course_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES courses (id), "pinned" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pinned" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "note_task_links" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(id) = 36 AND substr(id,9,1) = '-' AND substr(id,14,1) = '-' AND substr(id,19,1) = '-' AND substr(id,24,1) = '-' AND length(replace(id,'-','')) = 32 AND replace(id,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND substr(id,15,1) IN ('1','2','3','4','5','6','7','8') AND substr(id,20,1) IN ('8','9','a','b')), "note_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES notes (id), "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("note_id", "task_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "daily_priorities" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(id) = 36 AND substr(id,9,1) = '-' AND substr(id,14,1) = '-' AND substr(id,19,1) = '-' AND substr(id,24,1) = '-' AND length(replace(id,'-','')) = 32 AND replace(id,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND substr(id,15,1) IN ('1','2','3','4','5','6','7','8') AND substr(id,20,1) IN ('8','9','a','b')), "day" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(day IS NULL OR (length(day) = 10 AND day GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND substr(day,1,4) != '0000' AND date(day,'+0 days') IS NOT NULL AND date(day,'+0 days') = day)), "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id), "slot" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(slot IN (1, 2, 3)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("day", "slot"), UNIQUE ("day", "task_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(id) = 36 AND substr(id,9,1) = '-' AND substr(id,14,1) = '-' AND substr(id,19,1) = '-' AND substr(id,24,1) = '-' AND length(replace(id,'-','')) = 32 AND replace(id,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND substr(id,15,1) IN ('1','2','3','4','5','6','7','8') AND substr(id,20,1) IN ('8','9','a','b')), "singleton" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(singleton = 1) UNIQUE, "theme" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(theme IN ('system','light','dark')), "planning_zone" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(planning_zone) BETWEEN 1 AND 100), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "installations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(id) = 36 AND substr(id,9,1) = '-' AND substr(id,14,1) = '-' AND substr(id,19,1) = '-' AND substr(id,24,1) = '-' AND length(replace(id,'-','')) = 32 AND replace(id,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND substr(id,15,1) IN ('1','2','3','4','5','6','7','8') AND substr(id,20,1) IN ('8','9','a','b')), "singleton" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(singleton = 1) UNIQUE, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX courses_visibility ON courses (deleted_at, archived_at)
CREATE INDEX tasks_status_updated ON tasks (deleted_at, status, updated_at)
CREATE INDEX tasks_deadline ON tasks (deleted_at, deadline_boundary_utc)
CREATE INDEX subtasks_task_order ON subtasks (task_id, deleted_at, position)
CREATE INDEX notes_visibility_updated ON notes (deleted_at, pinned, updated_at)
